evals.prompt: Please analyze the design system of https://vercel.com and generate a complete DESIGN.md file following the standard 9-section format. Save the output as DESIGN.md in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A DESIGN.md file with all 9 sections filled in: Visual Theme & Atmosphere, Color Palette & Roles, Typography Rules, Component Stylings, Layout Principles, Depth & Elevation, Do's and Don'ts, Responsive Behavior, and Agent Prompt Guide. The document should be 500+ lines, include specific hex values and CSS values extracted from the vercel.com website, and contain thoughtful design analysis in Section 1.

assertions.text: DESIGN.md file exists in the outputs directory
File contains all 9 section headings (## 1. through ## 9.)
File contains a markdown table with typography hierarchy (| Role | header row)
File contains at least 3 specific hex color values in #xxxxxx format
Section 1 opening paragraph is at least 100 words (analytical depth, not just a bullet list)

evals.prompt: 帮我从 https://linear.app 提取设计系统，生成一个 DESIGN.md 文件，保存到当前目录。
evals.expected_output: A DESIGN.md file covering Linear's dark-mode design language. Should include Linear's signature indigo-violet accent (#5e6ad2 / #7170ff), Inter Variable font with cv01/ss03 OpenType features, the dark near-black background (#08090a / #0f1011), and the ultra-thin rgba border system. All 9 sections must be present.

assertions.text: DESIGN.md file exists in the outputs directory
File mentions Linear's signature accent color (#5e6ad2 or #7170ff or similar indigo value)
File references a dark/near-black background color (e.g., #08090a, #0f1011, or similar)
File mentions Inter as the primary font

evals.prompt: 去看一下 https://stripe.com 的设计风格，整理一份 design.md 出来放在当前目录，格式要按照标准的9个章节来。
evals.expected_output: A DESIGN.md for Stripe covering: sohne-var variable font with 'ss01' OpenType feature, weight 300 as the signature headline weight, blue-tinted multi-layer shadow system (rgba(50,50,93,0.25)), Stripe Purple (#533afd), and deep navy headings (#061b31). All 9 sections present with design analysis depth.

assertions.text: DESIGN.md file exists in the outputs directory
File mentions Stripe's brand purple (#533afd or similar purple hex)
File contains rgba shadow values (Stripe's blue-tinted multi-layer shadow system)
File mentions sohne font family (Stripe's custom variable font)
